attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Fineotex Chemical Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 with the BSE and NSE. The company reported a total manufacturing capacity of approximately 2,68,000 MTPA across five plants in the USA, India, and Malaysia. Promoters participated in a fund raise of Rs. 3,425.5 million via preferential allotment. Bonus shares were issued in a 4:1 ratio, and equity shares were sub-divided in a 1:2 ratio. ICRA upgraded the long-term credit rating to AA- with a stable outlook and the short-term rating to A1+ with a positive outlook. The company remains debt-free. Additional factory land of 7 acres was purchased at Additional Ambernath MIDC. Government approval was received for AquaStrike Premium. The company holds NABL accreditation for the fourth consecutive year and GreenPro certification for its cleaning and hygiene product range.

attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Earning update on Unaudited Financial Result for the Q2-H1 FY 2026-27".
voiceSummary: Fineotex Chemical Limited released its unaudited consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for Q2 FY27 reached Rs. 391.41 crore, up 169.1% year-on-year. Half-year total income stood at Rs. 778.13 crore, a 166.8% increase. Q2 operating EBITDA was Rs. 59.59 crore, while half-year operating EBITDA was Rs. 118.74 crore. Profit after tax for Q2 was Rs. 44.55 crore, and Rs. 92.75 crore for the half-year. The company reported consolidated return on invested capital of approximately 36.12% for the half-year. Fineotex is expanding its U.S. water and wastewater solutions business through Fineotex America Inc. It also acquired a 53.33% controlling stake in CrudeChem Technologies Group to broaden its international footprint in oil and gas specialty chemicals.

voiceSummary: Abans Enterprises Limited has placed two resolutions before members for approval via postal ballot through remote e-voting. The first is a special resolution to approve the disposal of the undertaking or assets of Abans Gems and Jewels Trading FZC, a step-down subsidiary. The second is an ordinary resolution to approve material related party transactions between Abans Jewels Limited and Abans Middle East FZCO. The cut-off date for voting rights is November 06, 2026. Remote e-voting commenced on November 13, 2026, and ends on December 12, 2026. Ms. Rachana Shanbhag has been appointed as the scrutinizer. Results will be announced within two working days after the conclusion of e-voting.

attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Fineotex Chemical Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Consolidated Total Income from Operations increased by 169.14% to Rs. 391.41 crore for the quarter and by 166.81% to Rs. 778.13 crore for the half year. Consolidated Operating EBITDA rose by approximately 92.04% to Rs. 59.59 crore quarterly and by approximately 111.22% to Rs. 118.74 crore half-yearly. Consolidated Profit After Tax increased by 70.82% to Rs. 44.55 crore for the quarter and by 81.51% to Rs. 92.75 crore for the half year. Consolidated business volumes grew by approximately 132.30%. The Statutory Auditors issued unqualified Limited Review Reports on the results.
